description: This line plot illustrates the validation performance, measured in BPC (Bits Per Character), of two different models—SMoE and SimSMoE—over the course of training, with the x-axis representing training steps in units of thousands (up to 50,000 steps). The y-axis, labeled “BPC,” ranges from 1.0 to 2.2 and shows a decreasing trend for both models, indicating improved performance as training progresses. The black line with cross markers, labeled “SMoE Validating,” begins at approximately 2.15 BPC at 0 training steps and declines sharply to around 1.15 BPC by 20,000 steps, after which it stabilizes with minor fluctuations. The purple line with square markers, labeled “SimSMoE Validating,” starts slightly lower at about 2.1 BPC and follows a similar steep decline, reaching approximately 1.12 BPC by 20,000 steps and remaining relatively flat thereafter. Both lines converge near 1.1 BPC after 30,000 steps, with SimSMoE consistently maintaining a slightly lower (better) BPC than SMoE across the entire training duration. The plot includes a grid for easier reading of values and a legend in the upper right corner identifying the two models.
